channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: Louisiana still imprisons people convicted by ‘Jim Crow juries’
item.description: “If it's racist now in [2026], it was racist back in 1980 when my client was convicted.”

item.title: We asked a MAGA congressman if ICE’s use of deadly force is justified. His answer should scare all of us.
item.description: The killing of American citizens in Minneapolis has ignited national outrage. But at least one MAGA congressman pointed the blame elsewhere.

item.title: US’s largest nurses’ union demands abolition of ICE after Alex Pretti killing
item.description: The union vowed to do everything in its power to ensure Congress members who vote to fund DHS are voted out.

item.title: Trump’s government hasn’t won its case against Mahmoud Khalil—yet
item.description: We speak with one of Mahmoud Khalil’s lawyers about what the latest ruling in his case means, what comes next, and how the future of free speech in the US hangs in the balance.

item.title: Immigrant children lead uprising at Texas detention center
item.description: The immigrant jail, where many children are detained, has “horrible” conditions, including “putrid” drinking water.

item.title: Largest nurses union calls to abolish ICE after Alex Pretti killing: ‘They messed with the wrong profession’
item.description: “What Alex did that day was pure instinct, pure professional behavior,” NNU President Mary C. Turner tells us. “That’s just what you do when you're a nurse.“

item.title: Raskin says nationwide general strike may be needed to stop Trump
item.description: “I think the people of Minnesota have shown us…the direction we may need to go,” the Maryland Democrat said.

item.title: ‘Beginning of the chaos’: FBI raid in Georgia seen as ominous sign of Trump plans for 2026 midterms
item.description: “This should have people across the country absolutely shook,” said Sen. Jon Ossoff.

item.title: TikTok takes down Gaza journalist Bisan Owda’s account mere days after US deal
item.description: Owda’s account had 1.4 million followers, she said.

item.title: ‘Totalitarian nonsense’: Don Lemon arrested by federal agents over coverage of church protest
item.description: “I don’t care what your political beliefs or leanings are, what journalism outlet you represent,” said one fellow journalist, “this absolutely cannot stand.”
